mapper.sql: (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_agent_deployments deployment WHERE deployment.tenant_id::text=${directTenant} AND deployment.agent_id::text=${directAgent}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_agent_deployments deployment JOIN public.nw_tenants institution ON institution.id=deployment.tenant_id AND institution.status IN ('active','warning') WHERE deployment.tenant_id::text=${directTenant} AND deployment.agent_id::text=${directAgent} AND public.agent_grant_chain_available(deployment.grant_chain,deployment.tenant_id,deployment.definition_id,'execute') AND (${directPrincipal} != 'SERVICE' OR ${directChannel}='chat' OR deployment.integration_id=${directIntegration} OR (${directTargetKind}='GROUP' AND deployment.integration_id IS NULL))))

NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_chat_sessions trusted_source LEFT JOIN public.nw_tenants institution ON institution.id=trusted_source.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_institution_integrations integration ON integration.tenant_id=trusted_source.tenant_id AND integration.integration_id=trusted_source.integration_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_integration_business_scopes business_scope ON business_scope.tenant_id=trusted_source.tenant_id AND business_scope.integration_id=trusted_source.integration_id AND business_scope.scope_id=trusted_source.business_scope_id WHERE trusted_source.tenant_id::text=${directTenant} AND trusted_source.session_id=${directSession} AND (institution.status IS NULL OR institution.status NOT IN ('active','warning') OR (trusted_source.integration_id IS NOT NULL AND integration.integration_id IS NULL) OR (trusted_source.business_scope_id IS NOT NULL AND business_scope.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active')) )

EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_group_bindings g JOIN public.nw_tenants institution ON institution.id=g.tenant_id AND institution.status IN ('active','warning') JOIN public.nw_integration_business_scopes scope ON scope.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND scope.integration_id=g.integration_id AND scope.scope_id=g.business_scope_id AND scope.status='active' WHERE g.tenant_id::text=${groupTenant} AND g.id::text=${groupId} AND g.status='active' AND (${groupPrincipal}='SYSTEM' OR g.integration_id=${groupIntegration}) AND (g.session_id=${groupSession} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_runtime_agent_run_bindings child WHERE child.tenant_id=${groupTenant} AND child.session_id=${groupSession} AND child.target_kind='GROUP' AND child.target_id=g.id::text AND child.role='DELEGATE' AND child.scope_snapshot->'origin'->'session_ref'->>'session_id'=g.session_id)))
mapper.select: SELECT authentication_ref, tenant_id, principal_kind, principal_id, integration_id, credential_version, session_id, end_user_id, channel, source, expires_at, active, target_kind, target_id FROM public.nw_runtime_authentication_facts WHERE authentication_ref = #{reference}

SELECT a.authentication_ref, a.tenant_id, a.principal_kind, a.principal_id, a.integration_id, a.credential_version, a.session_id, a.end_user_id, a.channel, a.source, a.expires_at, a.active, a.target_kind, a.target_id, v.identity_snapshot FROM public.nw_runtime_identity_verifications v JOIN public.nw_runtime_authentication_facts a ON a.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND a.authentication_ref = v.authentication_ref WHERE v.verification_ref = #{reference}

SELECT
(#{endUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND
)
(((((#{targetKind} = 'AGENT') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_agents WHERE tenant_id::text = #{tenantId} AND id::text = #{targetId} AND status = 'published')) OR ((#{targetKind} = 'TEAM') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_agent_teams t JOIN public.nw_agent_team_versions v ON v.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND v.team_id = t.id AND v.revision = t.published_revision WHERE t.tenant_id::text = #{tenantId} AND t.id = #{targetId} AND t.status = 'published'))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_end_users WHERE tenant_id::text = #{tenantId} AND id::text = CAST(#{endUserId} AS text) AND status = 'active')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_runtime_host_owners h WHERE #{targetKind} = 'AGENT' AND h.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND h.agent_id=#{targetId} AND h.session_id=#{sessionId} AND h.end_user_id=#{endUserId} AND (#{principalKind}='SYSTEM' OR h.integration_id=#{integrationId}))) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_session_owners WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND target_kind = #{targetKind} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND end_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{endUserId}) AND
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_waits WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{runId} AND input_id=#{input})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT g.id FROM public.nw_runtime_agent_run_bindings binding JOIN public.nw_group_bindings g ON g.tenant_id::text=binding.tenant_id AND g.id::text=binding.target_id JOIN public.nw_group_memberships member ON member.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND member.integration_id=g.integration_id AND member.group_binding_id=g.id JOIN public.nw_end_users usr ON usr.tenant_id=member.tenant_id AND usr.id=member.end_user_id AND usr.external_integration_id=member.integration_id WHERE binding.tenant_id=#{fact.tenantId} AND binding.run_id=#{runId} AND binding.target_kind='GROUP' AND binding.target_id=#{fact.targetId} AND binding.session_id=#{fact.sessionId} AND binding.end_user_id IS NULL AND g.integration_id=#{fact.integrationId} AND g.status='active' AND member.status='active' AND usr.status='active' AND member.end_user_id::text=substring(#{fact.source} from 15) AND (member.role='manager' OR member.end_user_id=binding.requester_end_user_id) FOR SHARE OF g,member,usr) current_operator)
mapper.sql:
(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_agents a WHERE a.tenant_id::text = #{fact.tenantId} AND a.id::text = #{agentId} AND a.status = 'published' AND ((#{fact.targetKind} = 'AGENT' AND #{fact.targetId} = #{agentId}) OR (#{fact.targetKind} = 'TEAM' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_agent_teams t JOIN public.nw_agent_team_versions v ON v.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND v.team_id = t.id AND v.revision = t.published_revision CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(v.definition->'team'->'members') member WHERE t.tenant_id::text = #{fact.tenantId} AND t.id = #{fact.targetId} AND t.status = 'published' AND member->>'agent_id' = #{agentId}))))
OR (#{fact.targetKind}='GROUP' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_group_service_agents service JOIN public.nw_group_bindings g ON g.tenant_id=service.tenant_id AND g.integration_id=service.integration_id AND g.id=service.group_binding_id JOIN public.nw_agents actual ON actual.tenant_id=service.tenant_id AND actual.id=service.agent_id AND actual.status='published' WHERE service.tenant_id::text=#{fact.tenantId} AND service.group_binding_id::text=#{fact.targetId} AND service.agent_id::text=#{agentId} AND service.status='active' AND g.status='active' AND (#{fact.principalKind}='SYSTEM' OR service.integration_id=#{fact.integrationId})))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_runtime_host_owners h WHERE #{fact.targetKind} = 'AGENT' AND #{fact.targetId} = #{agentId} AND h.tenant_id = #{fact.tenantId} AND h.agent_id = #{agentId} AND h.session_id = #{fact.sessionId} AND h.end_user_id = #{fact.endUserId} AND (#{fact.principalKind} = 'SYSTEM' OR (#{fact.principalKind} = 'SERVICE' AND h.integration_id = #{fact.integrationId}))))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nw_runtime_authentication_facts (authentication_ref, tenant_id, principal_kind, principal_id, integration_id, credential_version, target_kind, target_id, session_id, end_user_id, channel, source, expires_at, active) VALUES (#{authenticationRef}, #{tenantId}, #{principalKind}, #{principalId}, #{integrationId}, #{credentialVersion}, #{targetKind}, #{targetId}, #{sessionId}, #{endUserId}, #{channel}, #{source}, #{expiresAt}, true)
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nw_runtime_authentication_facts SET active = false WHERE authentication_ref = #{reference} AND active
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nw_runtime_identity_verifications (verification_ref, authentication_ref, tenant_id, scopes_snapshot, identity_snapshot) VALUES (#{reference}, #{authentication}, #{tenant}, #{scopes}, #{snapshot})

INSERT INTO public.nw_runtime_security_audits (audit_ref, verified_tenant_id, operation, result, policy_revision, subject_digest, trace_digest) VALUES (#{reference}, #{tenant}, #{operation}, #{result}, #{revision}, #{subjectDigest}, #{traceDigest})
